Orders and higher classification of vascular plant families

Source: R/data.R
vascular.families.Rd

Orders of the families of vascular plants (angiosperms, gymnosperms and pteridophytes). For angiosperms, orders and higher levels of classification follow the fourth update of the Angiosperm Phylogeny Group (APG IV, doi:10.1111/boj.12385 ); higher levels are the names of nodes of the consensus tree (Figure 1 of APG IV). Orders of gymnosperms and pteridophytes were obtained from the website of the Missouri Botanical Garden. Used by WFO.family() and WFO.browse().

Usage

vascular.families

Format

A data.frame with 476 rows and 10 columns:

Group

Group.

Family.ID

Unique ID for each family; for angiosperms, as in APG IV.

Family

Name of the family.

Family.taxonID

taxonID in the World Flora Online.

Order

Name of the order.

Order.taxonID

taxonID in the World Flora Online.

Node.1

Name of the node in the consensus tree.

Node.2

Name of the node, nested within Node.1.

Node.3

Name of the node, nested within Node.2.

Node.4

Name of the node, nested within Node.3.

Source

The Angiosperm Phylogeny Group et al. (2016). An update of the Angiosperm Phylogeny Group classification for the orders and families of flowering plants: APG IV. Botanical Journal of the Linnean Society 181: 1-20. doi:10.1111/boj.12385

Examples

data(vascular.families)
head(vascular.families[, c("Family", "Order", "Node.1")])
#>              Family            Order Node.1
#> 1     Amborellaceae     Amborellales       
#> 2     Hydatellaceae      Nymphaeales       
#> 3       Cabombaceae      Nymphaeales       
#> 4      Nymphaeaceae      Nymphaeales       
#> 5 Austrobaileyaceae Austrobaileyales       
#> 6      Trimeniaceae Austrobaileyales
